thread:
mira: Heads up — canary perf CI red after driver 12.10.2 rollout. tiny-seq small-batch p95 ~2x. Uploaded traces and logs: https://internal.perf/trace/2625901234
ci-bot: CI job perf_canary_smallseq failed at 2625901240 — p95 48ms -> 102ms (seq<=64). Artifacts: /artifacts/2625901234
mira: nvprof/nsys timeline + triton stderr attached. quick grep shows autotune table rebuild on startup and new kernel choices. snip logs below:
```
[triton] Autotune: rebuilding table due to driver version bump
[triton] Selected kernel=matmul_opt_v2_priority_high for sm90
```
ash: can you run a focused bisect on autotune changes? this smells like a kernel-selection priority flip after the driver bump
omar: ran bisect -> culprit commit f3c9a2b: "triton: prefer high-throughput kernels on sm90 when driver>=12.10.2". Repro on canary h100/a100. Perf delta: p95 +95% for small batches, throughput -30%
vince: nsight capture shows long matmul kernels scheduled ahead of many short kernels (serialized execution). small batches blocked behind heavy kernels -> tail latency spikes. also saw kvcache warm entries evicted more frequently (kvcache miss rate +12%) which increases token work
elaine: can we hotfix scheduler to prefer low-latency kernels for routes with <=64 tokens? quick toggle would buy time
mira: pushed quick patch to canary: scheduler tweak `prefer_low_latency=true` for small_batch routes. Test results: p95 back to ~56ms (not perfect), throughput slightly down. logs: /artifacts/2625901301
ash: good short-term. create PR for release branch revert of the autotune behavior if needed
omar: opened issue INF-742: autotune-driver-aware safety + metrics. Proposal: (1) safety gate that prevents switching to high-throughput kernels automatically on driver bumps for latency-sensitive routes, (2) telemetry for kernel-selection changes, (3) kvcache eviction counters tied to scheduling events
deploy-bot: starting rollback of triton-AUTOTUNE commit f3c9a2b -> previous at 2625901402
ci-bot: Canary perf job passed after rollback. p95 50ms -> 53ms. artifacts: /artifacts/2625901580
mira: Nice. Action items: revert commit on release branch (ash), autotune safety gate + tests (omar), add kvcache eviction telemetry (vince). I'll follow up with runbook for future driver rollouts
vince: adding nsight capture to nightly perf suite to surface kernel-priority flips and kvcache churn
mira: thanks team :thumbsup:
